sqlite_binding_candidate.database_scope: isolated Pilot v3 ledger only; leave the existing application GORM SQLite driver unchanged
sqlite_binding_candidate.authorizer_installation: sqlite3.SQLiteDriver.ConnectHook calls SQLiteConn.RegisterAuthorizer for every physical connection before pool admission
sqlite_binding_candidate.build_requirement: CGO_ENABLED=1 with a supported C compiler; Linux CI/reference-host validation is mandatory
sqlite_binding_candidate.release_gate: pin an exact driver version and verify the pinned API, license, Windows distribution, all physical pool connections, capability clearing, and performance before implementation

capability_isolation: The sole SQLite writer is serialized. Capabilities are unexported typed method scopes, cannot be selected by callers, and are cleared in a defer/finally path. Statements are prepared and executed only inside the scope; no raw SQL API or prepared statement cache crosses capabilities. Authorization checks run before any write transaction; commit barriers revalidate the full method-specific tuple.
unscoped_policy: All DML to listed tables is denied outside the exact capability. Direct DML to capacity counters and alert events is always denied; only the named SQLite trigger source is accepted. ATTACH/DETACH, TEMP objects, schema DDL, ANALYZE/REINDEX after initialization, and mutating PRAGMAs are denied on every application connection.
